dod_rows.dod: genpatch real round-trip against actual pinned files: apply -> verify -> revert byte-exact
dod_rows.notes: Fetched 2 pinned files (46882 B + 4240 B) + 4 spike payloads; patch 19214 B, sha256 cf0b020fd33ed6d02b62016dfc4ba156f0ddf714e717ebaedf3341e28a4979d9; 6 files, 466 insertions. apply PASS, verify PASS, revert PASS byte-exact (sha256 of every file compared pre/post, no residual paths).
